purpose: Documented changes to sources pinned by archived evidence. Archived metadata is never edited; a pin is satisfied by its original digest or by an amendment whose impact on that evidence is assessed below.

changes: purification cycle / round-budget / <2-anchor failures withhold p, adjusted p, decisions and classes
materially negative nested LR (< -2e-6) returns NaN with a reason instead of clipping to 0
ordinal logistic: BFGS start + Newton polish of the same statsmodels likelihood (tighter MLE)
ordinal SMD weights only strata containing both groups

evidence_impact.validation/ordinal_dif_total_rest, valid: assessed from archived records without rerunning: 0 omnibus LR within 1e-4 of the chi2(2) .05 critical value (Newton polish changes LR by ~1e-6, no decision can flip); 6 of 60,000 archived LR values were exactly 0 (clipped); at most those analyses would become invalid instead of non-rejections, changing any archived rate by <= 6/2500 = .0024. Archived FWER/FDR conclusions (ordinal inflation under impact) are unchanged; the records remain evidence for the recorded source only.
